blurb: Hawaii Fly Outfitters specializes in sight fishing for large bonefish and other flats species of the Hawaiian Islands. They offer guided fly fishing trips on Maui with experienced guides who help guests enjoy and learn fly fishing. The owner/guide Johann Hoogland has over 10 years of guiding experience on the flats of Maui.
